Assistant Professor and Head of DepartmentBCA (Bangalore University), MBA (Bangalore University), Ph.D. (Pursuing at Jain University) Linkedin Link Mr. Jagadish A. is an Assistant Professor in the BBA and BBA-AM departments with over 16 years of teaching experience. He holds an MBA and is pursuing a Ph.D. from Jain University. He worked at Don Bosco Institute of Bio-sciences & Management Studies and also has corporate experience with Bharti Infotel Ltd. and ICICI Bank Ltd. He has served in key roles such as IQAC Member, Staff Council Secretary and Cultural Committee Convenor. His research contributions include publications, book authorship and patents in consumer behaviour analytics and e-commerce. Specialisations and Interests Marketing and Information Technology Publications and Career Highlights Published a research paper titled "Consumer Buying Pattern in Digital Marketing" in IJMDRR, Volume 7, Issue 12, December 2021. Published a research paper titled "A Study on the Interrelation Between Job Satisfaction and Employee Performance" in IJMDRR, Volume 7, Issue 12, December 2021. Published a chapter titled "Social Entrepreneurship in the Digital Age: Online Platforms and Community Building" in the peer-reviewed edited book “Confluence of Curiosity: Multidisciplinary Explorations in Modern Research,” Volume 1, ISBN: 978-93-5879-799-2, DOI: 10.25215/9358797991.
